_about: A small contract between prose and executable guard behavior.
Each quote must exist in the cited file and each command is evaluated
against the live rule engine. Detailed coverage belongs in hooks/cases.py.
$BRANCH in a command is replaced with the fixture's actual branch, so a
claim does not break when a fixture is renamed.

claims.why: This is the central protected-branch promise.
A normal force push must remain blocked on feature branches too.
The one documented history-rewrite escape hatch must be usable.

claims.quote: Never read or write a real `.env`
claims.why: The credential boundary is a headline guarantee.
